description: P29 (plan M6-M9 §2.12, §5.4, decision 31): a house of a Crownmarch settlement - Brannock's eight along its main street, Millford's seven. Placed with the town's faction and the tag house (the world builder's breakable_site kind), so damaging one is an offence against the town (FactionState) and raiders can target it (P30's target provider, P37's raid). A stage-5 giant walking into one crushes it (trample_stage 5); a stage-4 giant fits the streets.
